say:1:1621136001:1.text: I'll stay out of sight so we don't spook them.
say:1:1621136001:1.source_cn: 为了不打草惊蛇，我就不过去了。
say:1:1621136001:1.male: I'll stay out of sight so we don't spook them.
say:1:1621136001:1.female: I'll stay out of sight so we don't spook them.

say:2:1621136002:1.text: Once you meet the contact, they'll figure out the package is fake sooner or later.
say:2:1621136002:1.source_cn: 一会儿你找到接头人，他们迟早会发现包里换成了假货。
say:2:1621136002:1.male: Once you meet the contact, they'll figure out the package is fake sooner or later.
say:2:1621136002:1.female: Once you meet the contact, they'll figure out the package is fake sooner or later.

say:3:1621136003:1.text: Before that happens, try to get them talking. If they spill anything useful, even better. And if you get real proof, don't hesitate to act.
say:3:1621136003:1.source_cn: 在那之前，要是能从他们嘴里套点消息最好，如果能拿到确凿...
say:3:1621136003:1.male: Before that happens, try to get them talking. If they spill anything useful, even better. And if you get real proof, don't hesitate to act.
say:3:1621136003:1.female: Before that happens, try to get them talking. If they spill anything useful, even better. And if you get real proof, don't hesitate to act.

say:4:1621136004:1.source_cn: 接下来我们见机行事吧。
